title: stateful-cohort-hedged-rollout-controller-with-rollback-snapshots
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a new stateful cohort hedged rollout controller that stores checkpointed snapshots for safe, session-consistent rollback. New APIs for snapshot inspection and manual rollback; console UI; instrumentation for SLOs and rollback metrics.
description:
Context: We need safer progressive rollouts for model variants that preserve session affinity and allow fast rollback without violating in-flight session consistency. Current canary/shadow controllers are stateless and either drop affinity or rely on ad-hoc cache invalidation which causes inconsistent user experiences and risk during rollbacks.

What this PR does: Implements a stateful 'Hedged Cohort Rollout Controller' that: (1) tracks cohorts and binds session anchors to a persistent snapshot record, (2) creates lightweight transactional rollback snapshots at configurable checkpoints, (3) supports hedged routing (send duplicate low-priority requests to candidate variants) for cold-start smoothing, and (4) exposes inspection and manual rollback APIs. The controller integrates with the serving runtime to invalidate KV caches deterministically during snapshot application.

Design notes: Snapshots are append-only records (migration id rollout_snapshots) with a compact diff encoding to minimize storage. Rollout policies are expressed as a single controller config (percent/phased/cohort map) with optional hedging window and snapshot cadence. To preserve session consistency we record anchor identifiers for active sessions and resolve them to the appropriate model revision during reads.

Files and surface changes: Adds orchestration/controller/hedged_rollout.go, orchestration/transactional_anchor.go, apis/v1/rollout_types.go, migrations/2026_02_26_add_rollout_snapshots.sql, console/pages/rollouts/snapshot_view.tsx, tests/e2e/hedged_rollout_flow.test.ts, docs/rollouts/hedged-controller.md, charts/templates/rollout-controller-deployment.yaml plus small changes to serving/runtime/cache_invalidator.go and prometheus metrics registration.

Testing: Unit coverage for controller decision graph (controller unit tests), integration tests between the controller and runtime cache invalidation (integration/rollout_cache_test), and an e2e scenario that simulates a live cohort with 30k requests and a mid-rollout manual rollback. Load tests run locally with the perf lab harness; results attached in PR comments.

Migration: Adds a backward-compatible DB migration (2026_02_26) that creates rollout_snapshots and snapshot_index tables. Migration includes a cleanup TTL for snapshots older than configurable retention.

Operational concerns & flags: Feature gated behind rollout.hedged_controller.enabled and rollout.snapshot_retention_days (default 7). We added metrics: rollout_snapshot_create_total, rollout_snapshot_apply_duration_seconds, hedged_traffic_ratio, hedged_failure_retries_total.

Checklist: [x] Controller implementation, [x] DB migration, [x] Unit tests, [x] Integration tests, [x] Console UI, [x] Docs, [x] Perf run, [x] SRE review.

Caveats: Snapshot diffs are not currently compacted across model family boundaries — we avoid cross-family compaction in this iteration. Future work: TTL compaction, snapshot delta compression, and RBAC controls for manual rollback APIs.
